analysis_input.job_text: Talent Intelligence Analyst, Global Specialty Recruiting, Amazon, Seattle or New York. Reviewed paraphrase of official posting 10569918, retrieved 2026-11-16. Responsibilities include market research across locations and competitors, quantitative and qualitative research, executive communication, data visualization, strategy documents, self-service dashboards, automated workflows and AI tools. Synthesize market trends and triangulate sources; advise recruiting, HR, finance and business leaders. Manage multiple projects and communicate delivery timelines independently. Must have 5 years of executive leadership advising experience. Must have 7 years of corporate recruiting experience focused on passive engineering candidates in technology markets. Must have a bachelor's degree or higher. Preferred: executive search experience, recruiting and people-related tools, CRM systems, and complex spreadsheets.

Interested in translating research into talent-market intelligence; has not built a self-service dashboard.
